item.description:
Unsure how accurate that article is. It states (quote):

In 2026, if you format a fresh Fedora, openSUSE, or Ubuntu Desktop installation, you’re running Btrfs by default.

This is false; Ubuntu Desktop ships with ext4 by default.

item.dc:creator: 0x506c61746f
item.description:
Good article here:

Danilo Falcão da Silva – 25 May 26

Btrfs vs ZFS on Linux in 2026: Practical Winner, Technical Winner

ZFS is the better filesystem; Btrfs is the better Linux filesystem — and in 2026, that distinction decides more than it should.

I will state I have only messed with Btrfs so I can’t say anything for or against ZFS nor how it would behave in and with Kicksecure.
